name: Two Hills
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #13 — mirror twin peaks flanking a low centre island over two voids: two tall trampoline hills (top 760) sit high on the outside, a low bubblegum island (top 1120) is stranded in the middle, and a central spring throne caps it. The centre is a hot seat — a hit either way rings you into a different chasm. 620px gaps, symmetric, no hazard.

GEOMETRY: LEFT PEAK (trampoline x0..1000 top760) / CENTRE island (bubblegum x1620..2380 top1120) / RIGHT PEAK (trampoline x3000..4000 top760), two 620px void gaps (left x1000..1620, right x2380..3000). One central spring THRONE (x1810..2190 top600 h48) hovers 520px above the centre island. Full-width lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -560..4560, ~560px side runway; bottom y1920 = 688px recovery under the centre, more under the peaks.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses a 620px gap in ~0.9s @ ~26 fuel; super 2800 clears all):
- GAP peak<->centre (two x 620px over void, with a ~360px height step): the horizontal 620px alone > 527 max spring drift and >> 395/320 drift. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED both ways; miss = fall into a chasm. Verb: FLY.
- REACH the CENTRE island: reachable only by boosting over one of the two 620px gaps from a peak (no bounce route) — that is what makes holding it exposed. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top600): 520px above the centre (1120). Bubblegum apex 180 reaches y940 -> 340px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: centre bottom (1232) to bottom blast (1920) = 688px recovery sky (>= 650); the small centre gives little runway so a knock off it is a shorter ring-out (hot seat). Verb: FLY.
- Both gaps exceed a spring bounce's reach and the throne sits above spring apex, so flight is required. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
